evidence.observation: Reboiler reads 431→445 °C, physically implausible for a ~500 mbar column whose next stage (T702) is only ~94 °C; drifting monotonically
Column temperatures rising steadily (~84→94 °C at T702), consistent with normal heat-up/advancing cut
Reflux flow noisy and low (0.12-0.24 L/h) with ratio scattering 5.9-7.3, distillate ~0.3 L/h
Condenser/top temperatures flat at ~63-64 °C while column heats, no vapour breakthrough to top yet

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature/heater duty reading or thermocouple recalibration to confirm T701 sensor fault, plus a distillate composition (GC) measurement
